entries.title: 海滩咖啡馆轻松人像
entries.note: Nano Banana 2 写实社交人像。
entries.prompt: A candid, photorealistic social media portrait of one young adult woman at a beach cafe, built around the Aesthetic. Show her with the Hair and Freckles, wearing the Outfit, seated at the Beach Cafe Setting and eating the Acai Bowl. Capture a relaxed moment between bites as she holds the spoon near her mouth and looks naturally toward the camera, with an open, confident expression. Give her a symmetrical attractive face, clear glowing skin, defined brows, soft lashes, lightly bronzed contour and a fresh natural lip color. Her figure is fit and well-proportioned. Use bright real morning or midday window light mixed with soft coastal daylight, gentle shadows, and natural reflections on the bowl. Frame the image as a waist-up candid shot with a phone-camera perspective, shallow depth of field, subtle photographic grain and authentic background activity kept softly blurred. Preserve real pores, fine skin texture, individual hair strands and anatomically correct hands. Beauty-retouched like a publishable creator post, never plastic or doll-like. Compose it in the Format. No text, watermarks, logos, usernames or borders.  Use these details: Aesthetic:  Surfer girl with relaxed coastal creator energy  Hair:  Long, tousled salty blonde hair with natural beach texture  Freckles:  Light freckles across the nose and cheeks  Outfit:  Faded blue surf T-shirt, white linen shorts and a delicate shell necklace  Beach Cafe Setting:  A bright beachfront cafe with weathered wood, open windows and glimpses of the ocean  Acai Bowl:  Purple acai bowl topped with banana slices, blueberries, granola and coconut  Format:  4:5 vertical social media portrait ve fashion-editorial mood.

entries.author: Mayz1169
entries.title: 角色像素 GIF 动作循环
entries.note: 上传角色参考图生成像素风循环 GIF。
entries.prompt:
Use the character I uploaded as the reference and make a downloadable looping pixel-art GIF of them performing a signature move.

[Keep the character consistent]
Study the reference and keep every key feature: hairstyle and hair color, face and eye color, marks or scars, outfit colors and patterns, accessories, and their weapon or prop. Same proportions and same look in every frame.

[Pixel art style]
Highly detailed HD pixel art, like premium 2D fighting game sprites: crisp hard-edged pixels, rich palette with pixel shading and highlights, visible fabric folds and hair strands, no anti-aliasing.
Full body, side 3/4 view, same size and same ground line in every frame.

[Design the move]
Pick a move that fits the character's personality, power or weapon (or use the one I give below).
Make it a short, punchy attack anyone can read at a glance: ready stance → wind-up → strike → follow-through → back to ready.
Add an elemental or energy effect that matches the character, rendered as pixel art (e.g. water waves, fire, lightning, petals).
Hair, clothes and effects react naturally to the motion. First and last frame match so it loops seamlessly.

[Output]
Pure white background, fixed camera, character centered with enough margin. No text.
About 12 frames, 1.5–2 seconds, infinite loop.
Deliver an actual multi-frame GIF file I can download.

entries.title: 黑衣金框墨镜男子街拍

entries.prompt: A medium shot from the mid-thigh up captures a young muscular man with a short groomed beard and dark espresso-brown wavy hair (#4A2A1C) cropped neatly above the ears with a forward-swept textured fringe reaching mid-forehead, showing organic curl separation, minor crown flyaways, medium volume, and a natural matte finish. Dressed in a jet-black (#121316) short-sleeve zip-neck knit polo shirt and matching black trousers, he wears thin metallic gold-rimmed (#D4AF37) rectangular sunglasses, a gold link wristwatch with a white dial on his left wrist, and a silver signet ring with a dark stone on his left ring finger. Posed to appear candid with a confident, composed, and aloof expression, his eyebrows remain neutral and relaxed above a direct gaze behind dark lenses while his slightly parted mouth meets the rim of a cream-white (#F1EDE6) ceramic espresso cup mid-sip. Seated and slightly reclined in a cafe armchair along the rule of thirds with his torso angled 30 degrees left, head facing the camera, and shoulders slightly tilted, his raised right hand pinches the cup handle in a light controlled grip between thumb and index finger—middle, ring, and pinky fingers curled neatly underneath and forearm veins prominent—while his relaxed left hand rests over his right thigh with loosely curved, slightly separated fingers. Set on an outdoor European-style cafe terrace with medium spatial depth, a pristine round matte white marble table with a smooth rounded edge appears in the lower-left foreground while the subject sits in a pristine matte black tubular metal armchair upholstered in burgundy wine (#6E2B37) and cream-white (#F1EDE6) vertical stripes in the lower-right midground. Behind him, a dominant aged column of dressed warm sandstone beige (#D8C2A7) blocks on the left exhibits a matte porous texture, natural mottling, horizontal masonry joints, and fine horizontal tooling striations, paired on the right with a well-maintained vintage mahogany-brown (#4A2A1C) satin-varnished wood window frame featuring recessed wood-grain paneling, a brass hinge, and glass reflecting warm circular bokeh lights. Moderately directional 45-degree front-left natural diffused daylight and soft ambient fill establish a warm, medium-high contrast scene with a sophisticated, calm mood, casting short, soft-edged gray shadows under the jawline, inside the right elbow crease, and beneath the left forearm alongside deep charcoal folds in the clothing, while preserved specular highlights accent the forehead, nose bridge, forearms, ceramic cup, gold watch links, and lenses across an analogous warm earth-tone and monochromatic black palette. Captured straight-on at seated chest-to-eye level as realistic editorial lifestyle digital photography on a full-frame camera with an 85mm prime lens at f/2.0, 1/250s shutter speed, and ISO 160, the image pairs tack-sharp knit fabric and skin textures with a shallow depth of field, European cafe street style and Old Money menswear influences, and warm color grading with rich deep blacks, creamy skin tones, and soft highlight roll-off, framed in a 3:4 vertical portrait aspect ratio.

entries.note: Midjourney V8.2 先锋漫画风。
entries.prompt: 一张极具视觉冲击力的日本先锋漫画风格插画，Japanese neo-pop art，Y2K Harajuku street fashion，复古日漫美学与现代实验性平面设计相结合，充满活力、幽默、疯狂而时髦的青春气息。 人物主体: 一位年轻的日系动漫少女，银白色略带淡粉色调的凌乱短发，蓬松厚重的刘海，发丝向画面四周自由飞扬，具有极强的线条流动感。戴着一副巨大的亮橙色圆框眼镜，镜片因透视关系产生明显的放大效果，透过镜片可以看到一双清澈明亮的青绿色眼睛。眼睛睁得很大，瞳孔精细，睫毛浓密且富有表现力，眉毛微微上挑，鼻尖小巧，脸颊泛着淡粉色红晕，带有细微雀斑与漫画排线。 少女张大嘴巴，露出粉红色舌头、整齐的白色牙齿和深色口腔，呈现突然惊讶、惊叫或兴奋大笑的夸张表情，充满感染力和戏剧张力。人物脸部被极近距离镜头放大，表情鲜活而自然。 服装造型: 少女穿着明亮柠檬黄色的宽松连帽上衣，夸张的oversized运动服廓形，带有厚重的布料褶皱与黑色手绘排线。前景一只巨大的袖子或手臂直接伸向镜头，袖子采用黑白高对比棋盘格图案，形成强烈的空间遮挡与前后景透视。服装局部带有黄色兜帽、黑白棋盘格布料和街头运动风格元素，整体呈现潮流、俏皮、具有设计感的原宿街头穿搭。 镜头与构图: 极端超近距离特写，仿佛镜头紧贴少女的面部，180度鱼眼视觉效果，强烈的桶形畸变，dramatic foreshortening，extreme perspective，wide angle close-up。人物头部向画面右侧倾斜，面部以大幅度斜向构图占据画面中心，左侧前景巨大的黄色袖子与黑白棋盘格布料产生夸张的近大远小效果。 少女的眼镜、眼睛、鼻子和张开的嘴巴成为主要视觉焦点，面部透视被适度夸张，呈现向镜头凸起的立体效果。发丝向上方与右侧延伸，形成富有速度感的弧形线条。人物脸部、肩部与前景布料相互交叠，画面具有明显的层次纵深与贴近镜头的沉浸式冲击感。 背景设计: 大面积鲜艳的珊瑚橙红色背景，搭配奶油白、黑色与明黄色的大胆几何色块。背景采用不规则的倾斜矩形、锐利的切割边缘与抽象平面图形，形成日本潮流杂志封面般的实验性排版设计。部分区域加入细小的黑色墨点、复古印刷瑕疵、油墨飞溅和细微的纸张颗粒。右下角具有醒目的黑色几何区域与明黄色复古字体图形，整体信息量适中，突出主体脸部的视觉张力。 绘画技法: 日本复古漫画与当代商业插画混合风格，精细的手绘黑色墨线，厚薄不均的轮廓线，具有速度感和节奏变化的发丝排线。面部采用大量细密短线刻画眼眶、睫毛、眉毛、鼻梁、脸颊、下颌与颈部阴影，传统漫画钢笔线描，精致的cross-hatching与ink hatching。色彩处理采用干净的二维硬边平涂，flat cel shading，minimal gradients，crisp black outlines，bold graphic shapes。 配色体系: 珊瑚橙红、柠檬黄、奶油白、粉白肌肤、青绿色眼睛、亮橙色眼镜以及深黑色墨线。高纯度色彩形成强烈互补与对比，画面明快、明亮、锐利，几乎没有真实摄影光影，不使用柔和的三维体积渐变。 整体视觉效果: 极端夸张的五官比例、充满张力的面部表情、强烈透视畸变、鲜明的撞色与高密度漫画排线。结合Japanese underground comic aesthetics，experimental editorial illustration，bold pop graphics，retro manga ink drawing，Y2K graphic design，整体像一张极具个性的日本先锋潮流杂志封面。 横向16:9构图，画面满幅铺开，超高清二维漫画插画，强烈的近景冲击力，无镜头黑边，无写实质感，无3D渲染。 Midjourney 参考提示词和 p 值: Japanese anime composition, extreme fisheye wide angle close up, heavy barrel distortion, dramatic foreshortening. Character's face pressed against the lens, centered, head tilted, bold diagonal composition. Facial features exaggeratedly enlarged, protruding toward camera. Arms/sleeves stretch toward lens, oversized in foreground, emphasizing near far size contrast. Overlapping limbs, face, and shoulders create spatial depth. Subject bursts beyond frame edges with bold cropping for immersive impact. Hair strands and clothing folds radiate outward, guiding gaze to face, enhancing speed and tension. Background features slanted geometric color blocks and sharp cutting lines echoing movement. Black 2D manga ink lines, hard edged flat coloring, high contrast clashing colors convey 3D space through line and color. Horizontal 16:9 full frame. No circular fisheye vignette, no photorealism, no 3D rendering. --chaos 50 --ar 9:16 --raw --profile z6jrcxw lvfb9ko --stylize 400 --v 8.2 --draft

entries.author: ThiThaoTri17219
entries.title: 东方工笔水墨思念女子
entries.note: 超写实与国画技法结合肖像。
entries.prompt:
Native 3:4 vertical composition, ultra-high-resolution experimental Eastern fine-art portrait, combining hyperrealistic cinematic photography with traditional Chinese watercolor, gongbi painting, and expressive ink-wash techniques. One independent image, no collage, no text.

An extraordinarily beautiful 25-year-old adult East Asian woman with a delicate oval face, luminous porcelain skin, expressive dark almond eyes, refined feminine features, naturally soft rose-colored lips, slender neck, narrow shoulders, and graceful proportions.

entries.prompt:
Create a 9:16 vertical photograph that looks like a friend snapped it on a compact digital camera during a grocery run at Sam’s Club. An adult East Asian woman with waist-length black hair wears a white or light-gray cropped deep-V top and low-rise blue denim shorts.

Frame her full body, head to toe, from a rear three-quarter angle, about 30–45 degrees behind her. Catch her mid-step with one hand on the shopping cart. Her hips and the cart still face down the aisle, but she turns her head back toward the camera with a small, natural smile. Her face is clearly visible over her shoulder. A few strands of hair swing with the turn.

Use a natural 35–50mm perspective. Keep the warehouse shelves, freezer cases and a few distant shoppers recognizable. Mix the overhead store lighting with cool white light from the freezers. Give the image soft contrast, subtle CCD grain and a little bloom around the brightest lights. Let the moving hair blur slightly while her eyes stay sharp.

Keep the cart’s handle, basket and wheels correctly aligned. Preserve natural hands and proportions. Avoid cropped feet, a straight-on fashion pose, plastic-looking skin, heavy blur, text or watermarks.
